samples.scenario: Misconfigured Google Cloud Storage (GCS) bucket with uniform bucket-level access disabled, allowing allUsers read permission resulting in public exposure of customer PII data.

technical_data.curl_command_to_access_sensitive_file:
curl -I https://storage.googleapis.com/customer-data-bucket/customer_ssn.json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 102400

{
  "ssn": "123-45-6789",
  "name": "Alice Johnson",
  "dob": "1985-05-15"
}

indicators: GCS bucket IAM policy includes 'allUsers' with roles/storage.objectViewer
Audit logs show storage.objects.get requests with empty principalEmail (anonymous user)
Access logs indicate external IPs retrieving sensitive customer files
Security Command Center detection of public read misconfiguration
IAM roles granted overly broad permissions including 'storage.admin' to allUsers
samples.detection_method: Use automated cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools to detect GCS buckets with public permissions; analyze Cloud Audit logs for anonymous access events; monitor access logs for unusual IPs accessing sensitive buckets; enforce organizational policies requiring uniform bucket-level access; integrate GCP Security Command Center findings with SIEM for alerting.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (anonymous access without authentication)
T1218 - Signed Binary Proxy Execution (via Google Cloud SDK)

samples.scenario: Azure Cosmos DB instance misconfigured with firewall rules allowing access from all IP addresses, exposing sensitive customer order data to the public internet.

technical_data.curl_command_to_access_sensitive_file:
curl -X POST https://sales-db.documents.azure.com/dbs/orders-db/colls/customerOrders/docs \
  -H 'Authorization: <valid-auth-token>' \
  -H 'x-ms-date: Wed, 03 Jun 2024 09:31:15 GMT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/query+json' \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.orderStatus = 'Pending'"}'

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "Documents": [
    {"orderId": "ORD12345", "customerId": "CUST6789", "orderStatus": "Pending", "amount": 250.00},
    ...
  ]
}
technical_data.azure_security_center_alert:
{
  "alertName": "Public Access to Cosmos DB Account",
  "severity": "High",
  "description": "The Cosmos DB account 'sales-db' is accessible from all IP addresses, violating the network security policy.",
  "resourceId": "/subscriptions/abc123/resourceGroups/prod-rg/providers/Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts/sales-db",
  "alertTimestamp": "2024-06-03T10:00:00Z"
}

indicators: Azure Cosmos DB firewall IP range filter set to wildcard '*' allowing all IPs
Activity logs show read key operations from unknown external IPs
Access logs document queries from external IPs not whitelisted
Azure Security Center alerts for public accessibility of Cosmos DB account
Role assignments with broad scope and unknown principals
samples.detection_method: Regularly audit Cosmos DB firewall rules to restrict to known IP ranges; monitor Azure Activity Logs for suspicious database key retrievals; analyze Cosmos DB query logs for anomalous access patterns; enforce Azure Security Center recommendations and alerts; implement role-based access control with least privilege; integrate findings with centralized SIEM.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (access with legitimate keys but from unauthorized IPs)
T1218 - Signed Binary Proxy Execution (Azure CLI or SDK usage)
